title: Skipper
description: Workflow, action, scheduler and storage health for services running Skipper with the skipper-metrics-prometheus plugin.

panels.title: Workflow starts
panels.description: New workflow instances created per second. Starts that resolved to an existing instance are not counted.

panels.title: Completions
panels.description: Workflow executions that ran to completion per second.

panels.title: Failures
panels.description: Workflow executions per second that ended in a non-retryable or unexpected error. Retryable errors are not counted here: the engine reschedules those.

panels.title: Action errors
panels.description: Share of action executions that threw, retryable errors included.

panels.title: Task backlog
panels.description: Scheduler tasks that are due and not yet picked up. Every instance reports the same store-wide count, so this is the maximum across instances, not the sum. A backlog that keeps growing means the fleet cannot keep up.

panels.title: Dead letters
panels.description: Scheduler tasks parked as failed. Each one is a workflow that stopped making progress until it is requeued from the admin UI.

panels.title: Saturation
panels.description: Tasks admitted across the fleet as a share of schedulerMaxConcurrentTasks. Empty when no concurrency limit is configured.

panels.title: Instances
panels.description: Processes currently reporting Skipper scheduler metrics.

panels.title: Workflow starts by outcome
panels.description: Calls that start a workflow. created: a new instance; existingNoOp: the instance already existed and the call attached to it; duplicateError: rejected as a duplicate; error: the start failed.

panels.title: Workflow executions by result
panels.description: One count per execution pass of a workflow method. wait and waitForRetry are passes that parked the workflow; completed, cancelled and the error results end it.

panels.title: Completions by workflow
panels.description: Completed workflow executions per second for each workflow class.

panels.title: Failures by workflow
panels.description: Workflow executions that ended in a non-retryable or unexpected error, for each workflow class.

panels.title: Retries and timeouts by workflow
panels.description: Executions that hit a retryable error and will run again, and workflows that exceeded their timeout.

panels.title: Signals
panels.description: Signals sent to workflow instances, and durable signals that could not be persisted.

panels.title: Action executions by result
panels.description: Action method invocations per second. Replayed checkpoints are not executions and are not counted.

panels.title: Action errors by action
panels.description: Action invocations that threw, retryable errors included.

panels.title: Action latency
panels.description: Time spent inside action methods, across all actions. Quantiles are estimated from histogram buckets, so they are only as precise as the timer buckets configured on PrometheusMetrics.

panels.title: Action p99 latency by action
panels.description: 99th percentile time inside each action method.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, actionClass, actionMethod) (rate({__name__=~"skipper_actionExecutor_actionExecutionTime_seconds_bucket", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Backlog and dead-letter queue
panels.description: Due tasks not yet picked up, and tasks parked as failed. Both are store-wide counts reported by every instance.

panels.title: Task throughput
panels.description: Tasks fetched from the store, taken off the in-memory queue by a worker, and handled. Fetched runs below the other two because a workflow started on this instance is queued here directly, without a fetch.

panels.title: Handled tasks by result
panels.description: Outcome of each task a worker handled. leaseLost, leaseContended and removedElsewhere mean another instance owned or finished the task.

panels.title: Concurrency by instance
panels.description: Tasks each instance holds, queued or running, against schedulerMaxConcurrentTasks. The limit line is absent when no limit is configured.

panels.title: In-memory queue size
panels.description: Fetched tasks waiting for a worker thread, by task type, summed over instances.

panels.title: Scheduler trouble
panels.description: Fetch rounds skipped because the instance was at its concurrency limit, errors in the fetch and worker loops, and tasks marked as failed.

panels.title: Scheduler store p99 latency
panels.description: 99th percentile latency of each scheduler call against the task table (MySQL or SQLite scheduler).

panels.title: Lease renewals
panels.description: Lease renewals for tasks that run longer than their lease. Failed renewals let another instance pick the task up while it is still running here.

panels.title: Optimistic locking conflicts
panels.description: Writes rejected because another writer changed the row first, by call site. A steady low rate is normal with several instances; a high rate means instances are contending for the same tasks or workflows.

panels.title: Store operations
panels.description: Calls per second to each workflow store operation (MySQL or SQLite store).

panels.title: Store errors by operation
panels.description: Workflow store calls that failed, by operation.

panels.title: Store write p99 latency
panels.description: 99th percentile latency of workflow store writes.

panels.title: Store read p99 latency
panels.description: 99th percentile latency of workflow store reads.

panels.title: Persisted payload size p99
panels.description: 99th percentile serialized size of workflow input, state and result as written to the store. Estimated from the value-histogram buckets (powers of four by default), so read it as an order of magnitude.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, operation, field) (rate({__name__=~"skipper_(mysql|sqlite)WorkflowStore_payload_size_bytes_bucket", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Timer expirations
panels.description: Durable timers firing, and the repairs made when a timer was recorded without its scheduler task.

panels.title: Compensation outcomes
panels.description: Compensation runs for workflows that failed after completing some of their actions.

panels.title: Callback and notification errors
panels.description: WorkflowCallbackHandler methods that threw, by callback, and failures notifying a waiting caller.

panels.title: Partition range by member
panels.description: Range of task-ID buckets each member fetches from. Ranges move when members join or leave. Reported only when task partitioning is enabled.

panels.title: Membership store p99 latency
panels.description: 99th percentile latency of the cluster membership heartbeat and member listing.

panels.title: Partitioning fallbacks
panels.description: Fetch rounds that fell back to an unpartitioned fetch because the member's partition could not be resolved.

panels.title: In-flight cancellation
panels.description: Cancellations reaching workflows that are executing: actions stopped or interrupted, and errors in the watcher.

panels.title: Version gate violations
panels.description: Workflow instances whose stored version for a change is outside the range the running code supports.

panels.title: Unexpected engine errors
panels.description: Errors the engine did not expect, and scheduler shutdowns that had to interrupt running tasks. Any non-zero value deserves a look at the logs.
